Name: Judith, Wife of Esau
Summary: Judith was the daughter of Beeri the Hittite and a wife of Esau.
KeyStory: When Esau was forty, he married Judith, and she and Bashemath, Elon's daughter, were a grief of mind to Isaac and Rebekah.
RelatedPeople: Esau; Beeri; Bashemath, Daughter of Elon
LifeLesson: A marriage outside God's promise brought grief to the whole household — a warning worth heeding.
